## Use Case

Describe the problem you are trying to solve or the capability you need.

## Proposed Solution

How you envision the feature working. Include any API changes, new configuration parameters, or new plugins you would expect.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you have thought of, and why the proposed solution is preferred.

## Additional Context

Any other context, references to papers, or examples that help explain the feature request.
